definitions.explanation: A break from work or school in the middle of the day, typically for eating lunch.

examples.japanese: {昼休|ひるやす}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What time does lunch break start?

examples.japanese: {昼休|ひるやす}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}しました→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk during lunch break.

examples.japanese: {昼休|ひるやす}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{昼休|ひるやす}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate lunch with friends during lunch break.

examples.japanese: {昼休|ひるやす}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a meeting after lunch break ends.

notes:
{昼休|ひるやす}み is composed of {昼|ひる} (noon) + {休|やす}み (rest/break).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {昼休|ひるやす}みに〜する: to do ~ during lunch break
- {昼休|ひるやす}み{時間|じかん}: lunch break time
- {昼休|ひるやす}み{中|ちゅう}: during lunch break

TYPICAL LUNCH BREAKS:
- Japanese schools: about 45-50 minutes
- Japanese companies: usually 12:00-13:00 (1 hour)

RELATED TERMS:
- {休憩|きゅうけい}: break, rest
- {昼食|ちゅうしょく}: lunch (formal)
- {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}: lunch
